svg.title: Journey: 2021–26 EFREI Innovation Lab, Trainer for the FabLab, AV studio and VR; 2022–25 EFREI 3D, Treasurer, then president of the 3D association; 2024 Univ. of Portsmouth, Two-month exchange in Creative Technologies; 2024–25 Datadidacte, Web & game developer, lead on Eurekin; 2024–25 EFREI, Lecturer in Green IT and game creation; 2026–28 Epitech, MSc Immersive Systems & VR, Strasbourg
